note: Family-owned RV park overlooking the Prairie Creek valley between the Ram and Clearwater rivers, about 30 minutes west of Rocky Mountain House and 300 m off pavement. ATVs may idle from the site straight to the trails; quad wash bays, propane and premium gas on site. A fresh-water fill station serves winter campers. Cabins and tent sites too. --Claude
